messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need a concrete plan to surface error signals in the Console for the new runtime dashboard. Focus: timeouts, 5xx, OOM, and degraded-mode/fallback counts. Who owns the source metrics and how we map them to panels?

jia: I can own the runtime-side metrics collection. Questions: do we want raw counts, rates, or both? Also need to decide dedupe semantics for retries.

sam_k: Both rates + 5m rolling count is useful. For retries we should count unique request IDs when available; otherwise expose both raw and deduped so dashboards can pick.

maria_g: From Console/UX POV we want a single "Error Breakdown" panel per route and a separate "Degraded & Fallbacks" panel with trend lines and top routes. Dimensions: model, route, deployment, region, customer_tier.

product_analytics: Agree on dimensions. Also want an event-level tag to know if a fallback was automatic (routing policy) vs degraded mode because of resource constraints.

alex: Good call. Proposal for canonical metric names (runtime team):
```
redwood_runtime_requests_total{status="2xx|4xx|5xx",route,model,deployment,region,tier}
redwood_runtime_timeouts_total{timeout_type="client|backend|gateway",route,model,...}
redwood_runtime_oom_events_total{node_type,model,deployment}
redwood_runtime_degraded_fallback_total{fallback_type="kv_cache|quantized_model|fallback_model",route,...}
```

jia: Will implement counters. Notes: timeouts we already expose from the gateway and from the runtime; names will be gateway_timeouts and backend_timeouts initially. We should standardize.

sam_k: For dashboard queries we'll need to join or align gateway vs runtime timeouts. Suggest we create a derived metric `redwood_runtime_effective_timeouts_total` that is the union of backend+gateway without double counting. Ops-bot can help with dedupe logic in telemetry pipeline.

ops-bot: @sam_k filed telemetry ticket #INF-482: "effective_timeouts aggregation". Pipeline PR template created.

maria_g: Dashboard layout ideas: top row KPI tiles (5xx rate, timeout rate, OOM count, fallback rate), second row heatmap by route x model, third row recent examples (links to trace ids). Also add an incident trigger panel that flags crossing thresholds for 5m/1h windows.

product_analytics: For SLOs we need 5xx_rate_per_route and fallback_rate_per_route. Thresholds will vary by tier. We'll add a mapping table in Console config.

alex: Decision points:
- Metric ownership: eng-runtime (jia) to instrument counters.
- Telemetry pipeline: eng-platform to add dedupe/derived metric (sam_k + ops-bot).
- Dashboard UX: eng-platform + product_analytics (maria_g, product_analytics).
- Alerts/SLO config: product_analytics + oncall.

jia: Action items:
- implement metrics with dimensions above (ETA: 2 days)
- add exemplars / request_id label when possible

sam_k: Action items:
- add pipeline job to compute `redwood_runtime_effective_timeouts_total` (INF-482). ETA: 4 days.
- build dashboard panels prototype in staging Console.

maria_g: Action items:
- mockups for Error Breakdown + Degraded panels, include drilldown flows. Will post PNGs here by EOD tomorrow.

product_analytics: Action: provide SLO thresholds per tier by Friday.

oncall-bot: New alert policy draft created: "runtime_high_5xx_rate" -> paged after 5m sustained over threshold for production tier. See #alerts-docs.

alex: One open question: how to count OOMs vs OOM-caused fallbacks? We need a downstream tag so we can attribute user-visible fallbacks to OOM root causes.

jia: We'll add `oom_triggered_fallback= "true|false"` on fallback metrics when we detect an OOM event in the same request path.

sam_k: Also worth adding a boolean `from_cache_hit` for degraded paths served from prefix/KV cache so we can separate performance-improving fallbacks from failures.

maria_g: UX note: in the UI, show a small legend for each panel describing any dedupe/derived logic so support knows what they're seeing.

alex: Great. If no objections I'll roll this into the infra roadmap and create the consolidated ticket with owners. Anyone want to veto or add constraints?

product_analytics: No veto, just please include sample PromQL and Grafana/Console queries in the ticket.

jia: I'll paste a quick PromQL example for a panel showing 5xx rate by route:
```
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total[5m])) by (route)
```

sam_k: Nice. For fallback rate: use derivation against requests_total with label `fallback="true"`.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-483 created: "Console dashboard: Error Breakdown + Degraded panels" assigned to maria_g with reviewers sam_k, jia.

alex: Thanks all — let's reconvene after the mockups and metric PRs land. :thumbsup:
